title: Needing Things for the Weather: nekem kell

sections.title: Who needs it
sections.content: You already know kell for "is needed." To say who needs it, use the dative pronouns: nekem ("for me"), neked ("for you"), neki ("for him/her"), nekünk ("for us"). Esernyő kell nekem. ("I need an umbrella.") or Kell nekem egy esernyő. — both orders are natural; nekem kell just puts the person first.

items.spanish: Esik az eső, esernyő kell nekem.
items.english: It's raining, I need an umbrella.
It's cold, he/she needs a coat.

sections.content: This is the same nekem pattern you'll meet again and again — kell nekem and similar constructions put the person who experiences something in the dative, not as a normal subject.
